target: Coordinate-first parcel resolution WITH GATE-0 retained: when a trusted pin (Google Places lat/lng) is present, resolve the NSW parcel by point-in-cadastre (Property/12) AND cross-check the cadastre address with parcel_identity_match, before the fuzzy text geocode. Fixes valid addresses that text-search + GATE-0 false-closed, without weakening wrong-parcel protection.
findings_summary: VALIDATED against the real 8-address corpus using each address's stored Google pin (property_reports.lat/lng) -> Property/12 point query -> parcel_identity_match cross-check: 14 Stanley/1 Coward/100 Ramsay resolve correctly; 2/45 Alt St + 5/1 Treacy (strata) NOW resolve (were text-path false-closes; normalize_addr_tokens strips the unit prefix '5/29'->'29' on both sides so a unit matches its base-property cadastre address); 22 Northwood + 15 Bay correctly REJECTED because the pin lands on a different parcel ('3 Northwood'/'28 Rockdale St') -> falls back to text -> 422 (wrong-parcel protection PROVEN intact). Multi-feature blocks (15 Bay 20 feats, Treacy 78, Alt 37) all collapse to ONE propid -> unambiguous. Property/12 propid EXACTLY matches the Portal propId (14 Stanley=1456609). Design: resolve_propid_by_point(lat,lng,address) in generate_conveyancing_report.py queries Property/12 (esri point JSON, inSR 4326, intersects), keeps only features whose cadastre address passes parcel_identity_match, resolves iff exactly ONE distinct matched propid, then reuses the existing /lot fetch (extracted to _lot_centroid_wkt, shared with resolve_address) for centroid+WKT. Wire coordinate-first into _resolve_address BEFORE the text fallback, still gated by _validate_coordinates; any miss/ambiguity/error -> None -> existing text resolve_address (+ its own GATE-0) -> 422. Safeguards confirmed: GATE-0 #514 reused not bypassed; #505 lot-area sanity runs downstream unchanged; fail-closed honesty preserved. No DB, no migration. Tests mock requests + _portal_get and cover: match, wrong-parcel reject, multi-feature single-propid, ambiguous distinct-propids, endpoint error, unit/strata base-address. GO.
